reviews.title: Fantastic and worth it for AI
reviews.comment: Works great. I have no idea why the other replies say it's bad because it's absolutely perfect for local AI. I use it for local models and it's fantastic! Way better than my old 3070. Be careful because it's super large (barely fit in my case!) and draws a lot of power (350W). While I'm sure the price could be better, to me it was worth it. It's not like incredibly loud or anything, for what it is. Also, MAKE SURE your PSU can handle it. My PSU couldn't and it literally started burning, but that was my fault for not checking beforehand!
reviews.author: A customer

reviews.title: Still a great card.
reviews.comment: Great card, still a workhorse. 24 GB Vram great for local AI.
reviews.author: Christopher Aleman

reviews.title: Space heater
reviews.comment: ...but we knew that. The included fans are sufficient to keep operating temps under 75c even when running Cuda all-out on an AI render. Manufacturer recommends 750w PSU for the overhead though the draw is more typically 450. But boy, does it turn that stuff into heat! Big card. Check ALL your measurements before sticking it in. It is just slightly fat in addition to being long. I stuck it in a Darkrock EC2 (mid-tower) and it was fine for clearance...did get a GPU support brace for it, though. Performance? I don't really do metrics. It spins up just great for games. My Satisfactories have never looked better.
reviews.author: Michael D. Sweeney

reviews.title: Damaged product
reviews.comment: The gpu looked brand-new with minor scratches giving away its refurbished nature. I purchased it for a new PC build, but immediately ran into several issues: first, my system wouldn't post (it was due to a gpu as without it everything worked fine) with a vga indicator lighting on my motherboard. On 5th attempt it finally started and as I was installing windows, it started producing artifacts. I rebooted the system again, and everything seemed fine for a minute or two. But then the entire system shutdown, gpu fans were spinning at their full capacity, and the gpu was quite hot to the touch, which I presume due to an issue with the cooling.
reviews.author: Rubilia
